audit.whatIsWrong: Chart read Skill/Kennen/Kennen/Skill/Skill/Kennen/Kennen against a packet of Kennen, Kennen, Skill, Kennen, Skill, Kennen, Kennen on a 57.17% win rate over 927 games.
audit.why: Kennen owns 1-2 outright (950 Q against a shotgun cone with no Quickdraw yet), level 3 is the coinflip when the dash arrives, 4-5 returns to Kennen's poke edge, 6 is even because Quickdraw plus the smoke can answer the ult, and first item onward is Kennen.
audit.corrected: Rows 0, 2 and 3 flipped as matched full/content pairs.

audit.whatIsWrong: The cooldown block named Quickdraw with no number and no mention that it is not a fixed timer.
audit.why: Quickdraw is 16/15/14/13/12s but hitting champions with basic attacks lowers that cooldown and refreshes the resistance boost — so counting a flat 16s while he is auto-attacking will get you caught. Smoke Screen is 26/24/22/20/18s, the longest punishable cooldown in the lane.
audit.corrected: breakdown.cooldowns rebuilt around Smoke Screen's 26s and Quickdraw's 16s with the attack-refresh caveat stated.

audit.whatIsWrong: Five fields call Smoke Screen a blind that stops your autos and your R from connecting.
audit.why: Riot's text is 'a cloud of smoke that reduces sight range. Enemies caught in the initial impact are dealt magic damage and have their Move Speed reduced' — the kit file flags slow and zone, no blind anywhere. It cuts vision and slows; it does not make attacks miss. Playing around a blind that does not exist means holding autos you should be throwing, while the real problem — you cannot see him to aim a 950-range Q — goes unaddressed.
audit.corrected: whys[4], spikes[1].text, early, mid and wants.foe[0] now state the sight cut and the slow.

audit.why: The missing-interactions file claims End of the Line cuts your retreat with terrain, but Riot's own description is 'fires an explosive shell that detonates after 1 second, or after colliding with terrain' — it reacts to terrain, it does not create any. The derived flag misfired.
audit.corrected: Nothing written; recording the flag error rather than acting on it.

edits.before: Your R stun-locks him but his E dash and W-blind can answer it — it comes down to your flash timing versus his escape, so it reads even.
edits.after: Your R stun-locks him, but Quickdraw and the Smoke Screen sight-cut answer it — your Flash timing against his escape, so it reads even.

edits.before: Slicing Maelstrom stun-locks him through his E dash and smoke, but he'll W-blind your R autos — flash on top before he kites out.
edits.after: Slicing Maelstrom stun-locks him through Quickdraw, but Smoke Screen cuts your sight and slows you — Flash on top before he kites out.

edits.before: Blind your R and auto chain with W (Smokescreen) so your marks never reach three stacks
edits.after: Cut your vision and slow you with Smoke Screen (W) so your marks never reach three stacks

edits.before: Graves wins the trade if you walk into shotgun range, so poke him only with max-range Q (Thundering Shuriken) and let Electrical Surge autos chip when he steps up to last-hit. His True Grit gives him resistances stacking in combat, but your magic damage cuts through it, and at levels 1-2 you out-range his shotgun cone — keep throwing Q on cooldown and don't chase, because his E dash punishes overextension. Bait his Smokescreen (W): once that blind is down, your autos and marks land clean.
edits.after: Graves wins the trade if you walk into shotgun range, so poke him only with max-range Q (Thundering Shuriken) and let Electrical Surge autos chip when he steps up to last-hit. His True Grit gives him resistances stacking in combat, but your magic damage cuts through it, and at levels 1-2 you out-range his shotgun cone — keep throwing Q on cooldown and don't chase, because his E dash punishes overextension. Bait Smoke Screen (W): it cuts your sight and slows, and it is 26s at rank 1.

edits.before: Levels 4-5 you keep the poke edge but respect his E-dash burst — don't stand still loading a third mark where he can reposition behind you and shotgun. At 6 your Slicing Maelstrom is the all-in: Q-W-E to stack Mark of the Storm, then R to stun-lock him through his dash and smoke. Flash on top first if he holds E, because a free Graves will dash out the back of your storm and W-blind your follow-up autos.
edits.after: Levels 4-5 you keep the poke edge but respect his E-dash burst — don't stand still loading a third mark where he can reposition behind you and shotgun. At 6 your Slicing Maelstrom is the all-in: Q-W-E to stack Mark of the Storm, then R to stun-lock him through his dash and smoke. Flash on top first if he holds E, because a free Graves dashes out the back of your 550 storm and smokes your vision of him.

edits.before: - Graves Quickdraw: matchup-defining — His dash + armor stacks. Engage when it's down. Track it before every engage. - Your committal tool: never spend it on chip. - Your ultimate: the win condition — kill windows only.
edits.after: - Graves Smoke Screen: matchup-defining — 26s at rank 1; it blanks your vision, so you cannot aim a 950 Q. - Quickdraw (16s, but his autos cut it): dash plus resistances. - Your R: flat 120s, kill windows only.

notes: The 'blind' claim was on this page five times and is not what Smoke Screen does — it reduces sight range and slows, per Riot's own text; nothing in the kit makes attacks miss. The Graves Q derived flag ('creates terrain') contradicts Riot's description and was not used.
